raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "qredis" %}
{% set version = "1.0.0" %}


package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.io/packages/source/{{ name[0] }}/{{ name }}/qredis-{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 67b1e11e106ff8e68418b25ff06e55d772f529f94c13197927b63fdd299d51b9

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  entry_points:
    - qredis=qredis.window:main
  script: {{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv

requirements:
  host:
    - pip
    - python >=3.5
  run:
    - msgpack-python
    - msgpack-numpy
    - qtpy >=2
    - pyqt >=5
    - python >=3.5
    - redis-py

test:
  imports:
    - qredis
    - qredis.images
  commands:
    - pip check
    - qredis --help
  requires:
    - pip

app:
  entry: qredis
  icon: logo.png
  summary: Qt based Redis GUI
  type: desk

about:
  home: https://github.com/tiagocoutinho/qredis
  summary: Qt based Redis GUI
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  description: |
    A Redis client GUI written in python and based on Qt.
  dev_url: https://github.com/tiagocoutinho/qredis
  doc_url: https://github.com/tiagocoutinho/qredis

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - tiagocoutinho
